tasks.gr11-democracy-human-rights-t3: Topic: Democracy and Human Rights. Cover the South African Bill of Rights, forms of discrimination and their effects, the value of diversity and inclusivity, social justice principles, and advocacy as a tool for challenging injustice. Ask Grade 11 learners to interpret a rights-based source, identify a rights violation and the applicable right, evaluate how advocacy can address discrimination, or argue for a more just and inclusive society.
tasks.gr11-democratic-structures-participation: Topic: Democratic Structures and Participation. Cover the three branches of government (legislative, executive, judicial), local and national government structures, elections and proportional representation, mechanisms for public participation, accountability and the rule of law. Ask Grade 11 learners to explain how a government structure functions, describe how a citizen can participate in democracy, analyse an accountability scenario, or evaluate the role of the judiciary.
tasks.gr11-media-ideology-citizenship-t3: Topic: Media, Ideology and Active Citizenship. Cover how media shapes opinion through selection, framing, and language; propaganda techniques; the role of ideology in news coverage; critical literacy skills for evaluating sources; and how citizens can use evidence-based argument to engage in civic conversations. Ask Grade 11 learners to analyse a media text for bias, identify propaganda techniques, compare two sources, or construct an evidence-based argument on a civic issue.
tasks.gr11-physical-education-task-3-t3: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 3. Cover athletics skills and conditioning principles, the responsibilities of safe and inclusive leadership in physical activity, the value of recreational participation, and sustaining effort over time. Ask Grade 11 learners to demonstrate or describe leadership in a physical activity context, record participation and reflect on effort, explain safe practice principles, or set personal activity goals.
